summary: Build a strategy office charter, governance cadence, and executive reporting pack in 5 days. Learn practical tools and templates for real delivery.
lede: Strategy office setup and governance helps professionals supporting strategy delivery, performance oversight and executive reporting create a clear operating rhythm. The training covers defining a charter and decision rights, setting review cadence, mapping KPIs, overseeing portfolio priorities and preparing leadership reporting packs. Exercises also address stakeholder escalation, action tracking and digital reporting workflows using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support strategy delivery, performance governance, and executive reporting in organizations that need a more disciplined operating rhythm. Strategy Office Leads responsible for governance design and executive cadence. PMO Managers coordinating strategic initiatives and escalation paths. Portfolio Analysts tracking dependencies, benefits, and initiative status. Governance Coordinators preparing meeting packs and action logs. Executive Assistants supporting strategy reviews and committee documentation. Strategy Analysts building KPI trees and performance dashboards. Corporate Planning Officers aligning objectives, targets, and reporting cycles. Chief of Staff professionals managing leadership follow-up actions. Business Performance Managers linking scorecards to operating reviews. Transformation Office Coordinators overseeing cross-functional strategic tracking.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a basic working knowledge of Excel and Microsoft 365, and familiarity with your organization’s strategy or performance reporting cycle. If available, prepare a sample KPI dashboard, strategy update pack, meeting agenda, or portfolio tracker from your current work so you can use it during the exercises.
